status: Additional exploratory covariate-adjustment after raw paired-domain comparisons; not preregistered.
outcome: First observed intercity continuation within five years is domestic; unresolved next locations excluded. No recorded change and next international move are non-domestic categories.
sample: First observed confirmed international entry per author/destination country in2012-2018, sufficient later publication observation; same45 countries.
fitting: Equal total weight to destination countries; grouped binomial maximum likelihood without regularization.
inference: Country-cluster sandwich covariance with finite-sample correction; t44 reference; delta-method standardization, six paired probability contrasts Holm-adjusted.
standardization: For each domain retain pooled observed country/source/year/career distribution, weight countries equally. This is adjusted association, not causal intervention.
